description:
Tech Energi® is an exciting new range of quality power products for the tech-savvy to revitalize their devices at home, in the office, or on the move. Our products are built for high performance to meet high demands, designed to cope with a diet of social media, web browsing, apps, and videos.

Tech Energi® is brought to you by a team of experts with over 20 years of experience in the manufacturing and distribution of mobile device accessories. We have developed an excellent reputation based on quality and service.

All products are RoHS and CE approved. Have peace of mind that our products are ensured to provide safe and effective use.

3. Commissions and payment

When a customers is referred through the affiliate link and make a purchase on our website, you will receive a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. We may or may not send free product(s) to the affiliate at our complete descretion. Such products will not necessarily be eligible for Lifetime Warranty.

5. How We Track Referrals

UpPromote uses cookies to track users who have clicked on your affiliate link, so they need to be allowing cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, we cannot track them, and so we cannot pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies tracking duration is 30 days. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate. Customers can re-click the link to restart the tracking duration.

6. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@techenergi.com.

Go forward and refer!
